title: Organization (v1)
description: Who publishes the feed, the campus boundary and the meters included. Unknown extra fields are allowed.

egrid_subregion.description: The EPA eGRID subregion whose emission rate prices the campus electricity, for example RFCW. Optional.

sample_data.description: True while the site still shows the template's made-up sample numbers. Optional: when absent, treat as false.

website.description: The parish's own website, when it has given one. Optional.

boundary.description: What the reported emissions cover and what they leave out.

meters.description: The meters inside the boundary, by generic id. Real meter or account numbers are never published.
